# Crates

Generated by `codespec-docs` from `cargo metadata --no-deps`: every Rust package of the workspace, with the `description` its `Cargo.toml` gives. There are 7 packages. None is on a registry; depend on them by Git or by path. The Go adapters (`codespec-read-go`, `codespec-write-go`) are Go programs in [`adapters/go`](https://github.com/beyond10x/codespec/tree/main/adapters/go) and are not listed here.

## Components

The model, the passes, the harness, the `codespec` command and the Rust writer adapter.

| Package | Version | Directory | In Rust | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `b10x-codespec-cli` | 0.1.2 | [`crates/cli`](https://github.com/beyond10x/codespec/tree/main/crates/cli) | `use codespec_cli`, binary `codespec` | The codespec command: validate cir/1, print its schema, apply the passes, run reader and writer adapters and the comparison harness |
| `b10x-codespec-harness` | 0.1.2 | [`crates/harness`](https://github.com/beyond10x/codespec/tree/main/crates/harness) | `use codespec_harness` | Runs every implementation of an example on seeded traces and requires byte-equal output |
| `b10x-codespec-model` | 0.1.2 | [`crates/model`](https://github.com/beyond10x/codespec/tree/main/crates/model) | `use codespec_model` | The cir/1 code intermediate representation: Rust types, strict reading, canonical JSON and its JSON Schema |
| `b10x-codespec-passes` | 0.1.2 | [`crates/passes`](https://github.com/beyond10x/codespec/tree/main/crates/passes) | `use codespec_passes` | Passes over cir/1: lookup-guard and the whole-module facts writers read |
| `codespec-read-rust` | 0.1.2 | [`adapters/rust-read`](https://github.com/beyond10x/codespec/tree/main/adapters/rust-read) | `use codespec_read_rust`, binary `codespec-read-rust` | Reads a Rust crate's src/lib.rs into one cir/1 module with syn and its own name and type resolution for the cir/1 subset |
| `codespec-write-rust` | 0.1.2 | [`adapters/rust`](https://github.com/beyond10x/codespec/tree/main/adapters/rust) | binary `codespec-write-rust` | Writes a cir/1 module and its facts as a Rust crate, built as syn trees and printed with prettyplease |

## Repository tooling

Generators and checks the repository's own gate runs. Nothing outside the repository depends on them.

| Package | Version | Directory | In Rust | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `codespec-docs` | 0.1.2 | [`crates/docs`](https://github.com/beyond10x/codespec/tree/main/crates/docs) | binary `codespec-docs` | Generates the derived pages of the codespec documentation site (CLI, crates, cir/1, status) and checks them for drift |
